name: aporic
description: Adds persistent intent lineage, effect receipts, evidence-aware verification, and exact-tool gates to opted-in Codex projects.

interface.shortDescription: Project commitments and gate exact tools.
interface.longDescription: From one global installation, discovers explicit project bindings, applies bounded intent-fidelity guidance per user turn, loads an observational commitment-state projection, and enforces one exact-action policy at preventive tool checks.
capabilities: Opt-in project discovery from one global installation
Persistent structured intent envelopes and plan lineage
PreToolUse hold, plan, and bounded-grant gate
PostToolUse effect receipts without raw payload retention or inferred success
Independent verifier-report ingestion bound to receipts and plan checks
Bounded MCP tools for capabilities, status, action explanation, and verifier reports
SessionEnd checkpoint publication and single-claim continuation
Argument relations, belief revisions, and decision retrospectives
interface.defaultPrompt: Show the active Aporic commitment state for this workspace.
